programs.title: Border Patrol
programs.desc: Employees of the Customs Service and the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry form a patrol guarding New Zealand's borders.The threat to the country is the smuggling of drugs, weapons and other illegal materials.

programs.title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
programs.desc: Behind the scenes of the fight against the international cocaine trade in the Caribbean.AMO agents and DHS investigators conduct intensive operations in Puerto Rico and neighboring islands, thwarting smuggling attempts.

programs.title: Tut's Treasures
programs.desc: British archaeologist Howard Carter discovered Tutankhamun's resting place in November 1922.The event became a real sensation due to the fact that it was the only pharaoh's tomb not plundered by thieves.More than 5,000 priceless items were found, including the famous golden mask, three beds and a throne.The most up-to-date findings about treasures hidden from the world for four thousand years will be presented.DNA tests conducted in museum laboratories revealed a dark secret hidden by the Egyptian ruler.

programs.title: The Spying Game: Tales from the Cold War
programs.desc: The creators of the program talk about operations undertaken during the Cold War by intelligence officers of the United States of America, the Soviet Union and other countries.

programs.title: Goulag: Une histoire soviétique
programs.desc: Millions of people were sent to forced labor camps in the USSR, including many Poles.Often their fate remained unknown.Not only criminals were sent there, but also political opponents and citizens who offended the system.Cheap labor in mines, quarries and logging was to support the economy.All documents have not yet been declassified.Knowledge about labor camps can be derived, among others, from literature - "The Gulag Archipelago" by Alexander Solzhenitsyn or "Another World" by Gustaw Herling-Grudziński.

programs.title: Air Crash Investigation
programs.desc: National Geographic inspires the explorer in everyone through breathtaking documentaries on science, history, and the natural wonders of our planet.

programs.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programs.desc: Whenever a civilian aircraft is attacked, innocent people die.Each such tragedy allows us to develop strategies to avoid threats.The catastrophe of the Russian Airlines plane Kogalywała, which took place on October 31, 2015 on the Sinai Peninsula, will be recalled.When the Korean 747 fell into the sea, the USSR authorities admitted that it had been shot down by mistake.A tragedy also occurred over the territory of Ukraine.A Boeing 777 belonging to Malaysia Airlines was hit by pro-Russian separatists with a Buk missile.At the scene of the incident, investigators had a difficult task due to the tense political situation.

programs.title: Mayday: Air Disasters 10
programs.desc: The tenth series of a program about the mysteries of tragic plane crashes.Modern computer graphics, interviews with witnesses and expert opinions recreate the events before the tragedy.

programs.title: Mayday 13
programs.desc: The series' creators solve the mysteries of the biggest plane crashes.Trying to recreate the events that took place before the tragedies, they reconstruct the situations that preceded them on board the machines.

programs.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report 3
programs.desc: Analysis of the most tragic accidents in the history of aviation.The investigation is based on reconstruction of events, photographic materials, accounts of survivors and rescuers, and computer graphics.

programs.title: Life Below Zero: First Alaskans: Season 3
programs.desc: A story about the indigenous people of Alaska who have lived according to the rhythm of nature for centuries.Each season has its own rules here.Tig Strassburg pragnie przekazać siedmiorgu dzieciom wiedzę i umiejętności pozwalające przetrwać w tym nieprzyjaznym miejscu.Young Apassingoks hunt for the entire local community.Joel Jacko combines tradition with modernity.Jody Potts-Joseph, on the other hand, begins a new chapter of life in her home village.Marvin Agnot survives on what he catches in the ocean or finds on the coast.John and Teresa Pingayak are also training the next generation.

actor: Self - Marvin's Nephew-In-Law - Glyndaril White Jr.
